question: When gain-only fails replication, does sequentially decoding the shared and attended-level microphone lanes and merging their timed segments recover total content without breaking attribution, overlap, speaker capacity, or bounded-load accounting?
scope: Diagnostic prototype only. It measures the content/latency/load/identity tradeoff of separate-lane decode and a deterministic merge. It does not authorize a production path or queue-policy change.

inputs.corpora: Exactly the four hash-pinned, 15.377 dB-calibrated corpora in the bound lane-balance v3 result.
inputs.microphone_lane: Decode the synthetically attenuated microphone lane, not its clean source.
inputs.reference: The same unattenuated clean-lane transcripts recorded in lane-balance v3.
inputs.baseline: The gain_0db mono-mix result recorded in lane-balance v3.

decode_policy.reason: Measure the two-request cost without bypassing the production single-worker fairness/backpressure contract.

merge_policy.namespace: Map sorted shared local labels first to S01.., then sorted microphone local labels to the next unused labels. Never reuse a label across lanes.
merge_policy.ordering: Stable sort by start time, lane order shared-before-microphone, end time, then source label.
merge_policy.overlap: Preserve overlapping segments with their original times; do not clip, deduplicate, or force turns to be disjoint.
merge_policy.render: Use live_span_bounds.render_segments and require parse-roundtrip equality.

metrics.content: The sealed v3 shuffle-edit total-content WER and operation counts against both clean references.
metrics.attribution: Every rendered segment maps to exactly one source lane; source labels from different lanes never collide.
metrics.merge_coherence: Parsed input/output segment counts, parse-roundtrip equality, label maps, and cross-lane overlap pair count/duration.
metrics.latency_and_load: Actual sequential wall time, per-request decoder elapsed/tokens, versus recorded mono baseline; request multiplier and token multiplier.
metrics.identity: Speaker-group count/capacity plus production ONNX WeSpeaker pairwise cosine geometry for mono-mix groups versus lane-isolated groups. Geometry is diagnostic, not an identity-accuracy score.

decision_rule.content_gate: Separate-lane merge improves total-content WER by at least 0.05 absolute on at least three of four corpora and worsens no corpus by more than 0.05 absolute.
decision_rule.structure_gate: All four outputs parse, preserve every parsed source segment, preserve every measured cross-lane overlap, use collision-free lane namespaces, and remain at or below 16 local labels.
decision_rule.latency_load_rule: Report the measured cost; do not invent an acceptance threshold before the end-to-end attended latency budget is attributed.
decision_rule.if_content_and_structure_pass: Prototype the minimal live dual-lane scheduling/identity seam and evaluate it together with the latency-cap sweep; do not ship yet.
decision_rule.otherwise: No mixer remedy is selected from this synthetic bed; obtain new real attended evidence before another production-policy attempt.
